title: Manipur Chief Minister-gi Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Manipur government health assurance scheme providing cashless treatment for eligible poor and vulnerable beneficiaries through government and empanelled hospitals.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on the current Manipur beneficiary identification criteria and notified categories.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Manipur Chief Minister-gi Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
